channel.title: Latest from Isaac Seiler
channel.description: Recent writing and updates from Isaac Seiler on Summation AI, OpenAI's ChatGPT Lab and Student Collective, AI education, public technology, WashU, and the Truman Scholarship.

item.title: Joining Summation to Lead Marketing and Communications
item.description: A new chapter in Seattle at Summation, bringing together AI, strategy, writing, and the work of making complex technology useful to real people.

item.title: What the OpenAI Student Collective Signals for Student-Led AI Learning
item.description: OpenAI’s new Student Collective points toward a practical model for campus AI learning: peer-led workshops, studio time, projects, and visible outcomes.

item.title: From ChatGPT Lab to the Classroom: Practical AI Education Use Cases
item.description: The most useful AI education begins with real tasks, clear limits, and enough context for teachers and students to exercise judgment.

item.title: What a 56-Government Index Revealed About Public-Sector AI Adoption
item.description: A 900-input benchmark turned scattered public information into a clearer picture of AI guidance, training, pilots, governance, and transparency.

item.title: From WashU and the Truman Scholarship to Public-Interest AI Work
item.description: How public service, journalism, the Truman Scholarship, a Rhodes finalist selection, and WashU shaped a practical approach to AI.
